reason: Adds an additive SQLite representation, API response fields, a settings toggle, a persisted Reserve model eligibility policy, and opt-in routing behavior while preserving existing normal-quota behavior and compatibility with older databases.
public_surfaces: Pool routing settings API and persisted Reserve model policy
OAuth account summary and detail API
release_note: OAuth Codex accounts now expose Luna Reserve status and can automatically fail over to Reserve Quota after classified normal-quota exhaustion; the automatic fallback switch defaults to enabled for OAuth routing, with a persisted upstream-bound model eligibility policy and bounded custom patterns.
